claim_boundary: mapped area/cell cost of the envelope unit only; no place-and-route, no timing closure, no fit claim, no audibility claim; RTL-vs-model agreement is tools/h04_compare.py's result

declared_vs_mapped_state.note: mapped and declared differ (here mapped is larger) and the mapping is behavior-preserving: yosys proc_rom extracts the levellut/statics case tables as ROMs and MEMORY_MAP re-implements them with registered logic, while next-state redundancies elsewhere merge. The contract the mapping must preserve is RTL behavior, proven bit-exact to the frozen model by tools/h04_compare.py on the pre-synthesis RTL.

full.requirement: mapped flops > 133 (irreducible 133-bit envelope slot) and chip area > 0 and sequential area > 0 and cells > 0

strip_negative_control.requirement: strip-observability must make the flop gate FAIL (all state removed)

rom_representation.detail: levellut + statics case tables extracted as ROMs by yosys proc_rom (2 found) and dissolved to combinational gates + registers by MEMORY_MAP; no BRAM exists in this flow and the final stat shows no memory cells

schedule_context.count_basis: one step per operator per frame (N03 cadence; NUM-005)
schedule_context.measured_worst_step_clks_source: tools/h04_compare.py bench (max_step_cycles over the directed set incl. worst-rate updates)

sequencer_structure.content: capture committed slot (the step's single read point, read-old) + staticcount_ -64 branch eval + decrement commit (write-new)

advance micro-sequence: scaleoutlevel target + clamp; rising_ + qrate (rate*41>>6 + rate_scaling, clamp 63); statics hold raw + //20 constant-multiply; staticcount_ * 15414067 >> 24; inc_ shift + * 15414067 >> 24; commit
movement branch: rising jump floor + ((17<<24 - level) >> 24)*inc clamp, or falling level - inc clamp; level commit; optional second advance launch

sequencer_structure.worst_case: capture + advance + movement + second advance = 13 clocks per frame step incl. worst-case segment advances (measured: see compare_report.json step_cycle_gate)

sequencer_structure.budget: H03 derived_estimate 24 clk/op/frame worst case; the measured 13 closes the contracted update slot with margin

tool_identity.constraints: no SDC: probe flow per issue #26 (read_verilog; synth -top; dfflibmap; abc; ltp; stat), no clock defined
tool_identity.dont_use_policy: none: *_1 drive cells allowed (declared per D01 section 4/section 10.3)
